farms._eligibility: Eligibility is Masonry stake ONLY (Jess, 2026-11-09: 'just masonry boost'). The farms fund the boost; only users who held stake in the Masonry (Boardroom) for the whole prior week, with zero Masonry LP withdrawals that week, earn it. Farm-pool stake alone never qualifies. Wiring, done by the operator before staking opens: ShareRewardPool.setMasonryBoardroom(boardroom) and Boardroom.setLoyaltyTracker(shareRewardPool) — stake changes made while unwired are unobservable.
farms._emissionSplit: The two farm pools are added to ShareRewardPool with alloc points 75 and 20. Worked example: of every 100 xSHARE the farms emit, 75 go to the xTOMB LP pool, 20 to the xSHARE LP pool, and 5 to the weekly loyalty boost (the weeklyBoostPercent below). The split stays exact because the boost is weighted against the pools' combined alloc points.
farms._weekLengthDays: Length of one loyalty week, in days. 7 = a calendar week. Set with setWeekLength BEFORE the farm start time — it locks the moment the farm starts, so week boundaries never move under stakers. Valid range 1-30 days. The 7-day progress bar in the app reads this same week.
farms._weeklyBoostPercent: Percent of farm xSHARE emissions routed to the weekly loyalty boost, paid to users who held stake in the Masonry for the whole prior week with zero Masonry LP withdrawals. 5 = five percent. The contract deploys with this percent already set (baked in, Jess 2026-11-09); the operator may re-set it live with setBoostPercent. Valid range 0-25; 0 turns the boost off. Changing it live is safe: accrual settles under the old percent first.

note: Weekly loyalty boost — specs.md §8 (farms) and §18 (weekly loyalty reward). The 5 percent is baked into ShareRewardPool at deployment; no operator step turns it on. Every value here is a whole human unit — percents and days, never bps or wei. Contract code converts.
